editorial:
Imagine you are a prison psychologist who just got the secret location of millions of dollars from a dying inmate. That is exactly where this ride starts. You get to follow the doctor as he heads to the quiet suburbs of New Jersey to score the loot, but there is a catch. Two convicts overheard the whole secret and broke out of prison to beat him to the punch. It is a classic cat-and-mouse game with a funny twist because the criminals are trying to blend into a fancy neighborhood where they totally do not fit in. The vibe is light, breezy, and feels like those great 90s comedies where everything just goes wrong in the best way possible.

What really makes this work is the chemistry between the characters and the fast pace. The acting is solid, and the jokes land well without trying too hard. While the plot is pretty simple, it keeps you guessing who will actually end up with the cash. If you love low-stress movies with a bit of crime and romance, you will dig this. You should definitely try renting it on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection for the best picture quality. It is the perfect choice for a lazy Friday night when you just want to laugh.
endingExplained: In the end, the chase leads to a big showdown where everyone tries to grab the money. The prisoners realize that stealing the loot isn't as easy as they thought. After some funny chaos and a few surprises, the doctor and the convicts clash one last time. The money eventually finds its way to those who actually deserve it, and the bad guys end up empty-handed, proving that crime does not pay in the end.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves lighthearted crime comedies and heist movies.
